description: THE LONG CON's declared flag vocabulary -- the canon dictionary, in the
shape the Garden established. The content validator reads it: a flag
written anywhere must appear here or be read somewhere, and a gate on a
flag nothing writes is an error either way.
IT EXISTS HERE BECAUSE THIS STORY IS A HYBRID. The two-direction check
runs over STRUCTURAL documents -- decks, clocks, threads, endings -- and
quests are not among them. `the_frame` legitimately winds on a flag the
QUEST declares in its `narrative_flags`, and the interview deck writes
flags that only prose and later scenes care about. Both directions are
correct and neither is visible to the check, so they are declared.
